page.overview:
Who is Dalaine Ndaye?

She was the first Amyrlin not of the Green-Blue-White axis since Bonwhin Meraighdin - a period of 179 years.

Dalaine held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in . She was Rabayn Marushta's successor and Edarna Noregovna's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}
